notes.title: A Tithe in Blood is now released!
notes.content: [h3][i][b]Find unexpected love in the depths of grief...[/b][/i][/h3][p][/p][p]Our next yuri visual novel, A Tithe in Blood, is out now![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45043283/ba0432d4dc1ffbb328b9e960e2efeee1aa3d67fe.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As a reserved and unassuming university student in snow-bitten Hokkaido, the personal tragedy which visited Honoka Asakawa leads her to experimenting in a magical art thought long-lost — blood magic. Unexpectedly able to visit the sealed world of Meiji-era Sapporo, Honoka's quickly taken under the wing of the cheerful and bright Lady Yasue, a powerful mage who's remained in this gilded cage for a century.[/p][p]As their feelings for each other develop, the true repercussions of Honoka's first steps into the secret world of magic and mages are only just starting to play out, eventually leading to catastrophic consequences.[/p][p][/p][h3]Features:[/h3][list][*][p]Original story of approximately 70,000 words[/p][/*][*][p]Concept and writing by Suriko[/p][/*][*][p]Character designs and art by Kobuta[/p][/*][*][p]Fully original soundtrack by Claire DeLuca[/p][/*][*][p]Fully voice acted in Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Story written in English with Japanese and Simplified Chinese translations[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][previewyoutube="1KsUQd2h3i8;full"][/previewyoutube][p]A Tithe in Blood also has an [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3783570"]artbook available[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3783570"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][b]Get the physical copy of [/b][url="https://vnstudioelan.com/store/A-Tithe-in-Blood-Classic-Edition-p754767604"]the VN[/url][b] or [/b][url="https://vnstudioelan.com/store/A-Tithe-in-Blood-Official-Artbook-p754766080"]the artbook[/url][/p][p][/p][h1][i]follow us on...[/i][/h1][h3][url="https://bsky.app/profile/vnstudioelan.com" style="button"]Bluesky[/url]  -  [url="https://vnstudioelan.com/newsletter/" style="button"]Newsletter[/url]  -  [url="https://www.patreon.com/vnstudioelan" style="button"]Patreon[/url]  -  [url="https://discord.gg/dNZYDaGbh9" style="button"]Discord[/url][/h3]

notes.title: Announcing Full Japanese Translation & Voice Acting!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that our upcoming dark yuri visual novel A Tithe in Blood will launch with Japanese language support and full Japanese voice acting!

Studio Élanの新作百合ADVゲーム『A Tithe in Blood 〜血の契り〜』が、日本語対応と日本語フルボイスでリリース決定！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45043283/00c3d5a080547cb017106c25e2731b762ce227ab.png[/img]

Thank you so much to Sarah Nelkin, Re,AER and Studio Tonaria!

[b]Casting Director, Localisation Manager:[/b] Sarah Nelkin (Re,AER LLC)
[b]Japanese Translation:[/b] Chisato Saito (Matsurika Games LLC)
[b]Proofreading:[/b] Neko Hattori
[b]Recording Engineer:[/b] Yusuke Kondo (Studio Tonaria)

[b]Honoka Asakawa[/b]
CV. Toka Itsuki (樹冬華)

[b]Yasue[/b]
CV. Mami Fujita (ふじたまみ)

[b]Shino Kikuchi[/b]
CV. Haruka Sugita (杉田春花)

[b]Kaoru Ito[/b]
CV. Haruka Okamura (岡村明香)

[b]Tatiana Fedorova[/b]
CV. Jenya (ジェーニャ)

[b]Yonehara[/b]
CV. Yuki Kyoka (京花優希)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45043283/b382905a56f6fb7489d56ca3245d11f1828b429a.png[/img]

We'll be posting character voice previews soon - please look forward to them! In the meantime, please wishlist A Tithe in Blood on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2989270/A_Tithe_in_Blood/
